failure_evidence.cause_boundary: Semantic Scholar returned a response whose data field was null during citation expansion.
failure_evidence.interpretation: The cached graph is a discovery pool only; it is not proof that any search cluster saturated.

fallback_protocol: Search each C01-C12 cluster independently in arXiv, DOI/Crossref, OpenReview/proceedings, and official organization repositories.
Verify every retained record against a primary paper, proceedings page, official product page, or tagged official repository.
Run supportive, disconfirming, and functional-equivalence passes separately.
Record venue status, fixed locator, inclusion decision, and last-verified date.
Report bounded coverage or measurement gaps instead of claiming universal literature saturation.
prohibited_inference: Do not report the 11896 cached candidates or 46 expanded nodes as a completed four-round snowball or as cluster saturation.
